Read mass spectra from an MGF file

mc_read_mgf.Rd

Import an MGF file as a Spectra object for fragment confirmation or synchronized peak-table and spectral export.

mc_read_mgf(path)

Arguments

path

Local MGF filename. Download a remote MGF to a local file before reading it.

Details

Requires the Bioconductor packages Spectra and MsBackendMgf. The file is read using the MsBackendMgf backend. Keep the local input file available while using the spectra. Reading does not match spectra to a peak table, merge duplicate feature spectra, or apply feature filters.

Value

A Spectra object containing the imported spectra and their metadata.

See also

mc_filter_ms, mc_filter_mgf, mc_export

Examples

if (FALSE) {
# The peak table and labels are bundled; only MGF requires internet.
mgf_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plyush1993/",
  "MetaboCensoR_Examples/main/orbi/orbi_iimn_gnps.mgf"
)
mgf_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".mgf")
download.file(mgf_url, mgf_file, mode = "wb")
spectra <- mc_read_mgf(mgf_file)
head(Spectra::spectraData(spectra))
}
